carousel_caption:
MrBeast posted for 5 years before his first hit. Most content creators quit long before that.

Four years in, he had about 30,000 subscribers. He kept going and studied what makes videos go viral, obsessively. In January 2017 he counted to 100,000 on camera. It took 40 hours, and it was his breakthrough. In June 2026 he became the first creator to reach 500 million subscribers.

The lesson isn't "post more". It's study what works, then post more.

Send this to a creator friend who's thinking of quitting, and save it for the day you are.

Source: Wikipedia, MrBeast
